name: automations
description: Prebuilt engineering automations: CI fixing, daily digests, security scans, issue triage, docs, tests, review-comment fixes, and feature-flag cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Prebuilt slash-command automations for everyday engineering upkeep.
interface.longDescription: A toolbox of ready-made engineering automations you can run on demand or on a schedule: /fix-ci roots out failing CI runs, /daily-digest summarizes the last 24 hours of repo activity, /vuln-scan hunts for exploitable security issues, /triage-issues works the issue backlog, /gen-docs drafts missing documentation, /add-tests covers risky untested logic, /autofix-review-comments takes a first pass at PR feedback, and /flag-cleanup plans dead feature-flag removal. Every automation reports findings first and only opens PRs when you explicitly ask. Pair with the scheduling-automations skill to run them recurrently.
